layer.yggdrasil_origins.origin.name: Origin
layer.yggdrasil_origins.path.name: Path
origin.yggdrasil_origins.amberborn.descr: A body of hardened amber: armour that mends, and mends others. The one origin built to stand in the front line and heal from it.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.amberborn.gives: Thick armor, near-immovable footing, a far better shield, strong healing magic and better recovery, paladin weapons and maces, and effects that slide off.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.amberborn.name: Amberborn
origin.yggdrasil_origins.amberborn.pays: Slow steps, clumsy rolls, amber burns long and fire magic is nearly dead in him, and a bow is almost useless in his hands.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.angel.descripti: A healer and support of heavenly blood.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.angel.gives: The strongest healing magic there is, three hearts more, armor, safe falls from any height, wand and stave.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.angel.name: Angel-Blooded
origin.yggdrasil_origins.angel.pays: His hand barely harms anyone — half damage in melee and with a bow, nearly every weapon is weaker, and fire magic is alien to him.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.aurelite.descri: A berehynia: the one who stands between a household and what comes for it. She wears a wreath, not a helm.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.aurelite.gives: A far better shield, mace and paladin weapons, healing magic, and complete immunity to poison and wither.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.aurelite.name: Berehynia
origin.yggdrasil_origins.aurelite.pays: In darkness her armor, healing and blows all fall apart; dark magic refuses her and she is a poor miner.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.blazing.descrip: A living flame and a fire mage.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.blazing.gives: Full immunity to fire and lava, walking on lava, regeneration without food, fire magic, ore smelted in his palm. The Pyromancer path pushes the fire to the ceiling.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.blazing.name: Blazing
origin.yggdrasil_origins.blazing.pays: Two hearts less and harder hits, water almost stops him and drowns him fast, frost and water magic barely work, shields and brews fail him.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.cantharis.descr: A forest nymph woven out of song — arcane magic and healing in one voice.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.cantharis.gives: Arcane magic and strong healing, faster casting, an extra roll, a little spell crit.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.cantharis.name: Mavka
origin.yggdrasil_origins.cantharis.pays: One heart less with almost no armor, harder hits, heavy steel deadens her singing, heavy armor cannot be worn at all, and at low health the voice breaks and all magic weakens.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.dragonborn.give: The thickest natural armor there is, almost immovable footing, fire magic, and a breath that sears what he hits. The Furnace path pushes the fire to the ceiling.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.dragonborn.name: Dragonborn
origin.yggdrasil_origins.dragonborn.pays: Slow and heavy with poor rolls and hard falls, outside healing lands badly, and cold stiffens the blood and slows everything down.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.dwarf.descripti: A master of the deep and a sturdy warrior.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.dwarf.gives: The fastest mining there is, luck in the stone, armor and resistance to knockback, poison and curses sliding off, heavy weapons and earth magic.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.dwarf.name: Dwarf
origin.yggdrasil_origins.dwarf.pays: Short legs, sinks in water and is useless with a pick underwater, all other magic ignores him, a bow draws slowly and the roll is mostly a fall.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.elf.gives: Much more bow and dagger damage, faster shots, longer and quicker rolls, light air magic.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.elf.name: Elf
origin.yggdrasil_origins.elf.pays: Two hearts less and thinner armor, every hit lands harder on him, heavy weapons and sweeping strikes are nearly useless.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.ferrine.descrip: A Cossack with liquid iron in his veins.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.ferrine.gives: The heaviest melee damage there is, armor, a far better shield, immovable footing, blows that land through plate.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.ferrine.name: Zaliznyak
origin.yggdrasil_origins.ferrine.pays: Rusts underwater and sinks, is nearly deaf to magic, steps slowly and recovers from a roll badly.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.geonite.gives: Armor and resistance to knockback, earth and nature magic, a fist like rock, blows bounced back at the striker, stone broken bare-handed, and a boulder's armor while crouched.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.geonite.name: Horyn
origin.yggdrasil_origins.geonite.pays: Slow steps and slow casting, lead weight with poor jumps and rolls, air magic is lost on him, stone fingers hold a tool badly.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.half_giant.desc: A mountain of muscle for the heaviest weapons.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.half_giant.give: Five hearts more, hard to knock back, far more damage with axes, two-handers and hammers, a punch like a wall.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.half_giant.name: Half-Giant
origin.yggdrasil_origins.half_giant.pays: Slow steps and slow swings, a frame too big for a two-block gap, clumsy rolls and hard falls; small weapons and all magic are wasted on him.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.halfling.gives: Luck and evasion, extra rolls and speed, poison and fear sliding off, rare meals, and better shooting and knifework than his size suggests; good brews last twice as long on him.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.halfling.name: Halfling
origin.yggdrasil_origins.halfling.pays: One heart less with almost no armor, two-handed steel is simply beyond him, and a brew works on him one level weaker.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.human.descripti: An ordinary human — no gifts and no curses. Every number stays exactly as Minecraft set it, so this is not a worse choice than any other — just a cleaner one.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.human.name: Human
origin.yggdrasil_origins.hydroletilus.de: A lord of the deeps with fish blood.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.hydroletilus.gi: Walking and swimming through water as if on land, breathing underwater, fast mining down there, strong frost and water magic, spear and shield.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.hydroletilus.pa: On dry land he drags and casts slowly, dry skin cracks and burns long, fire magic is the opposite of his blood, and heavy weapons pull him under.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.lisovyk.descrip: The forest wearing a shape. He grows rather than moves: bark instead of skin, antlers instead of a helm, and the patience of old timber. Fire is the one thing old wood has never learned to answer.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.lisovyk.gives: Earth and nature magic, armor and tenacity, four hearts more, a woodcutter's axe and a quiet step on forest ground.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.lisovyk.name: Lisovyk
origin.yggdrasil_origins.lisovyk.pays: Slow steps, slow swings and a clumsy roll; dry wood burns long and fire magic is dead in him; heavy steel and the bow are not his.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.lunaris.descrip: A folk healer whose power comes with the moon.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.lunaris.gives: The strongest healing magic at night and underground, faster casting, a wand, and healing that returns to her as well.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.lunaris.name: Molfar
origin.yggdrasil_origins.lunaris.pays: Direct sun wilts her, three hearts less with thin armor, and her hands cannot fight at all — neither in melee nor with a bow.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.mara.descriptio: The dread that sits on a sleeper's chest. She is barely there at all - thin, cold, and almost impossible to see when she holds still in the dark. Daylight takes her apart.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.mara.gives: Arcane and soul magic with fast casting, life drunk from spells, a dagger and evasion, and full stealth while she holds still in the dark.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.mara.name: Mara
origin.yggdrasil_origins.mara.pays: Three hearts less and every hit lands harder; direct sun strips her magic, her evasion and her speed; heavy iron and shields are nothing to her.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.orc.description: A war-bred people hard to kill on the first try.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.orc.gives: Heavy weapon damage, thick armor, one killing blow survived every few minutes, and far more strength and lifesteal when wounded; raw meat feeds him and grants strength.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.orc.name: Orc
origin.yggdrasil_origins.orc.pays: Spells crumble in his hands, every hit lands much harder, retreat and healing both go badly, cooked food feeds him worse.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_amberborn_: Amber hardens where it stops. So does he.
Standing still, armour, footing that cannot be moved and curses that slide off.
At a sprint the shell is soft: less armour and every blow lands harder.
An amberborn who gave up moving entirely in exchange for holding ground.
More armor still, an even better shield, and stronger healing on top.
Slower steps and no rolls at all.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_angel_dawn: A descendant of angels who keeps the hours of the sun, and pays for it after dark.
Under open daylight, faster casting and a quicker step.
In the dark the song falters: slower casting and easier to hit.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_angel_ward: An angel-blooded who gave the last of his own body for other people's wounds.
Far stronger healing magic and his own recovery with it.
Two hearts less, and every hit lands harder.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_aurelite_l: An aurelite who drank light and kept it.
Stronger healing magic and better recovery, by day or night, in the open or underground.
One heart less, harder hits, and a much weaker swing — what is left of the body is thin.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_aurelite_s: A berehynia who stands in front of other people. The shield is the whole of the craft.
With a shield in hand, a stronger block and curses that slide off.
A bow in those hands is a poor weapon, and she is planted where she stands.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_blazing_cr: A blazing one who let the fire out through the top of his head. It burns above him for everyone to see, and it burns through him just as fast.
Stronger fire magic and noticeably faster casting.
Two hearts less, and healing reaches him worse.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_blazing_em: A blazing one who holds the line. It all went into the body.
While on fire, armor, resistance to knockback and a harder swing — the skin bakes into a crust.
His fire magic and his casting speed both drop.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_blazing_fi: A blazing one whose blood boils over.
A burn on whoever strikes him, scaled to the attacker's own size — a small steady bite rather than a blow.
Two hearts less, and he burns much longer when set alight.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_blazing_py: A blazing one turned into his own fuel. Fuel is never sturdy.
While burning or in the Nether, much stronger fire magic — burning is his working state.
Thinner armor and every hit lands much harder.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_cantharis_: A mavka who learned to hold two notes at once.
Stronger arcane magic and faster casting.
One heart less, harder hits, and a wand that has lost its bite.
A cantharis reads a crowd the way others read one opponent. In a press of bodies nothing touches her.
With three or more living things close by, she slips between blows and moves faster.
Alone she hits softly, moves slowly and has a heart less to spare.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_dragonborn: A dragonborn who let the fire out of his blood.
Fire magic let loose from the blood.
Thinner scales and harder hits — the heat splits the plates from within.
Scales that were grown around a furnace. Fire is an old acquaintance; snow is not.
Flames go out on him faster and his own fire bites harder.
Frost magic comes badly to him, and in snow he stiffens and takes more.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_dwarf_forg: A dwarf who spends his life at the anvil.
Much more damage with hammers and maces, and thicker plating.
Slower steps, and a bow in his hands is nearly useless.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_dwarf_ores: A dwarf who barely comes up from the mine.
With no sky overhead, the fastest digging, better luck in the stone and sharper tools.
Under open sky he turns sluggish and swings unwillingly.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_elf_cold_h: An elf who lives at range. Reach the shooter once and he is not the same.
With a bow in hand and untouched, markedly more damage and faster shots.
For five seconds after any hit his hand shakes — he shoots worse and takes more.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_elf_venoms: An elf who poisons rather than kills outright.
A chance that the arrow leaves venom in the wound, and a lighter hand with rogue weapons.
Nothing extra — the poison itself is the whole path, and it fires only about one arrow in eight.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_elf_woodwi: An elf who no longer needs ground of his own.
A harder bow, a longer roll and blows that pass him by more often — anywhere, on stone as on grass.
Two hearts less, harder hits, and anything heavier than a knife.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_ferrine_ir: A ferrine who only feels right under a real breastplate. The iron is part of the body, with everything that costs.
In a proper chestplate: he is hard to move, hard to curse and takes less.
The same iron slows the step and the roll.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_ferrine_re: A ferrine who answers with his own body. He stands where others dodge.
Every blow that lands on him hands a part of itself straight back to the attacker — every blow, with no cooldown.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_free.descr: You stay with your origin alone. Every people has paths to choose from, so this is a deliberate choice: the origin as it is, with nothing added and nothing taken away.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_free.name: No Path
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_geonite_bu: A geonite who roots into the ground. A fight rarely lets you stand.
While standing still, armor, blows bounced back at the striker, and poison and curses sliding off.
Slower steps and a much longer wait between rolls.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_geonite_st: A geonite who no longer has to look for rock.
Earth magic that works the same in a mine and in an open field.
Part of his shell and a much weaker swing with warrior weapons.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_half_giant: A half-giant who refuses to go down on the first try.
At a fifth of his health the body throws a shield over itself, worth nearly a third of his health, once every three minutes.
He cannot roll at all — too much body to throw aside.
Ground that would break another pair of legs only jars his. He steps down from places other people climb.
Far less damage from a fall and footing that is hard to shift.
A heavy walk and a long wait between rolls.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_halfling_s: A halfling who settled on one weapon.
More ranged damage and a better chance at the weak spot.
One heart less, and warrior weapons stay beyond him.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_halfling_u: A halfling who learned that the surest way out of a fight is never being in it. Crouched, he is quicker than people expect.
Crouching, he moves much faster than a crouch should allow and is hard to hit.
One heart less, and no weight at all behind a heavy swing.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_human_levy: A human who was taught to hold a line, not to duel. Next to someone else he is worth twice what he is worth alone.
Armour, a heavier swing and curses that slide off while another player stands within seven blocks.
Away from everyone, slower steps and an easier target.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_human_road: A human who lives between villages. The more trodden the ground under her, the more of it she gets back.
Trodden ground around her stacks three times: a trail, a road, a paved street - up to +9% movement speed and +12% roll distance.
Travels light: three points of armour less and a slower roll, wherever she stands.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_hydroletil: A vodianyk who grew a shell for the pressure of the deep.
Thicker armor and a far better shield.
Slower steps and slower casting — a shell is carried, not simply worn.
A vodianyk who keeps a few shards of the deep turning around him. They take the blow before he does - and they are cold enough that the fire in him never catches.
More armor, a little more frost magic and tenacity.
Slower steps, and fire magic drops away almost entirely.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_lisovyk_gr: Under leaves the forest tells him where to put his feet. In the open it says nothing at all.
Among trees: curses slide off, the step quickens and earth magic bites harder.
In bare country he is exposed and takes more.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_lisovyk_ro: A lisovyk who stops walking and starts growing. Stand still and the roots take hold of the ground; move and you are only dragging them behind you.
While standing still: more armor, almost immovable footing and tenacity.
Slower steps and a much longer wait between rolls.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_lunaris_bo: A lunaris who only works in a pair. A healer without a group is just a healer.
With another player nearby, stronger healing magic and armor.
Alone every hit lands much harder and her healing weakens.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_lunaris_ti: She rises and falls with the light, as water does with the moon. Nothing about her is steady, and that is the point.
In the dark, quicker casting and blows that miss her.
Under open sun the tide is out: slow casting and every hit lands harder.
Water and rain are her floor. Where neither falls nor stands, she is a long way from home.
In water or under rain, a quicker step and blows that pass her by.
In the Nether the ring is broken: slow, exposed and easy to curse.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_mara_shrou: A mara who wrapped herself in the thing she feeds through. The shroud drinks for her - and leaves nothing for her own mending.
More life drunk out of her spells, and stronger soul magic.
One heart less, and outside healing barely reaches her at all.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_orc_bloods: An orc who smells the wounded.
Blood in the air carries him: next to anything wounded he moves faster and hits harder, and he finishes the bloodied far harder still.
A target at near-full health he hits reluctantly — an orc only warms up on blood.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_orc_shield: An orc who strikes through plate.
A quarter of the target's armor simply does not count, and roughly one blow in eight knocks the target out of its own swing.
Half his own plating and much harder hits.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_serpentfol: A serpentfolk whose new skin refuses poison and curses.
Far better resistance to effects and to spell damage — nothing sticks to fresh scales for long.
Outside healing lands worse and the skin itself is thinner than the old one.
The bite carries more than teeth. It costs him body to keep that much poison in reach.
A far better chance of poisoning what he hits, and a sharper knife.
One heart less: the glands take the room.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_sylph_stor: A sylph who saves herself for the weather that matches her. Most days she is simply thinner than other sylphs - and then the sky turns.
In a thunderstorm: stronger air and lightning magic, faster casting and much faster arrows.
One heart less and every hit lands harder - every hour the sky is clear, which is most of them.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_sylph_wind: A sylph who only works her magic airborne.
Off the ground — falling or jumping — much stronger air and lightning magic and faster arrows.
Two hearts less, and standing on the ground her air magic is weaker than a plain sylph's.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_tiefling_b: A tiefling who pays for power with his own blood.
Below a third of his health his spells hit far harder, drink life back, and carry him faster.
The body no longer mends itself at all — only brews, spells and other hands.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_tiefling_t: A tiefling who only truly wakes up in front of holy blood. Put an angel-blooded, an aurelite or an amberborn within sight and the demon in him stands up; leave him among his own and he sulks.
Within 16 blocks of an angel-blooded, an aurelite or an amberborn: stronger arcane magic, much more spell vampirism and faster casting.
Outside knife-range of holy blood he is simply worse: outside healing lands poorly and every hit is harder.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_undead_bon: An undead with nothing left but bones. Bones handle arrows well and maces badly.
Arrows, bolts and any projectile do far less — there is nothing between the bones to tear.
Everything that is not a projectile hurts more.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_undead_pla: An undead who spreads rot instead of force.
Stronger soul magic - a dead hand conducts another's power well.
His own blows with rogue weapons, axes and sickles land noticeably weaker.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_undead_rea: Much more damage to wounded targets, and every such hit heals you.
Noticeably less damage to a target at full strength — he cannot start a fight, only end one.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_undine_cur: A rusalka who gave herself to the current.
Blows that pass her by more often and a roll that carries further than anyone's.
One heart less, and every hit that does land hurts more.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_undine_pea: Under water she grows a shell the way an oyster does. On land it is only weight she does not have.
Submerged: armour and curses that find no hold.
Out of the water she is slower and every blow tells.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_vortan_iro: A fighter who absorbs blows instead of dodging. He traded the roll for a stance.
With both hands empty, all incoming damage drops by a fifth.
No rolls at all and slower steps.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_vortan_mom: A kharakternyk who wins on tempo.
Faster hands, a faster bow and faster spells than anyone else's.
Two hearts less, and every hit lands harder — speed is bought with a lighter body.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.path_werewolf_p: A werewolf who runs with somebody else's pack instead of leading one. What he hands the leader is four times what he keeps.
With his leader within 30 blocks his own blows land a little harder - and the leader's land much harder for his presence.
On his own he is simply a weaker werewolf who takes a hit worse.
A werewolf who leads a pack of his own kind. Two leaders cannot share one pack: bring a second one into range and both lose everything the pack gave.
For every pack member within 20 blocks: +3% rogue and +4% warrior weapon damage, up to three of them - +9% and +12% with the pack entire.
Alone he is worse than a plain werewolf, and a second pack leader in range strips the pack bonus from both.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.serpentfolk.giv: Precise dagger and rogue strikes, arcane magic, evasion, a good swimmer, and complete immunity to poison and wither.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.serpentfolk.pay: Three hearts less and harder hits, heavy steel is beyond him, and in snow and cold the blood stiffens and nearly shuts him down.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.sylph.descripti: A wind spirit that barely touches the ground.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.sylph.gives: Strong air and lightning magic, faster arrows, light weight with safe falls, extra rolls and evasion, a long glide while falling.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.sylph.name: Povitrulia
origin.yggdrasil_origins.sylph.pays: Three hearts less and harder hits, earth magic is closed to her, heavy iron and shields are useless, and under a roof the wind leaves her.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.tiefling.descri: A dark caster whose magic drinks the victim's life.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.tiefling.gives: Strong arcane and fire magic, spell vampirism, wand and knuckles, fire barely burns him.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.tiefling.name: Tiefling
origin.yggdrasil_origins.tiefling.pays: One heart less, healing magic is dead in his hands, outside healing lands poorly, every hit lands harder, a shield is dead weight.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.undead.descript: A walking corpse that lives off other people's lives.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.undead.gives: Strong lifesteal, soul magic, scythe and rogue weapons, minions raised on hit, no drowning at all, rotten food as proper food.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.undead.name: Undead
origin.yggdrasil_origins.undead.pays: Burns in sunlight, armor barely holds, healing almost fails, holy weapons scald, normal food feeds poorly, sinks like a stone.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.undine.gives: The strongest water and healing magic there is, free movement and breath in water, evasion, regeneration while in water, and good brews that last much longer.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.undine.name: Rusalka
origin.yggdrasil_origins.undine.pays: Two hearts less with poor armor and a poor shield, out of water the magic runs dry, fire evaporates her, in the Nether she dries out and dies, and harmful effects also last much longer on her.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.vortan.descript: A Cossack sorcerer-warrior who made a weapon of his own body.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.vortan.gives: A heavy bare-handed strike, fast hands, arcane magic from within, extra rolls and evasion, more speed with empty hands.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.vortan.name: Kharakternyk
origin.yggdrasil_origins.vortan.pays: Any weapon in his hand simply stops working; one heart less, no heavy armor and nothing to block with.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.werewolf.descri: A cursed beast in human skin.
origin.yggdrasil_origins.werewolf.gives: By night the deadliest claws there are, more speed and critical hits, sight in the dark.

Every hit on you returns 3% of the damage it dealt back to the attacker. Every hit, with no cooldown.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_geonite_bul: Movement speed -8%, roll cooldown +27%. Even he struggles to get moving.
While standing still: armor +3, damage reflect +15%, tenacity +15%. Stillness is his armor.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_geonite_sto: Earth spell power +5%. Stone answers him anywhere, not only underground.
Armor -4, warrior weapon damage -30%. He did not spend his strength on plating.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_half_giant_: Rolls -1: a half-giant has none at all. Too much body to throw aside.
When you are hit below 20% health: absorption worth 30% of your maximum health. Once every 3 minutes.
Reserve bar: when full, Second Wind is ready. It refills over 3 minutes.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_halfling_sl: -1 heart, warrior weapon damage -20%. Nothing heavy stays in these hands.
Ranged damage +10%, critical chance +5%. A small hand aims well.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_halfling_un: Max health -1 heart, warrior weapon damage -8%.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_human_levy_: With nobody within 14 blocks: movement speed -6%, evasion -5%.
With a player within 7 blocks: armor +2, warrior weapon damage +6%, tenacity +6%.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_human_road_: Armor -3, roll cooldown +10%. Nothing heavy ever goes in the pack, and nothing heavy moves fast.
With 6 blocks of trodden ground within 3 blocks: +3% movement speed, +4% roll distance.
18 blocks of it stacks on top: +3% movement speed, +4% roll distance again.
36 blocks of it stacks once more: +3% movement speed, +4% roll distance. A street is the most ground a road can be - +9% and +12% in all.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_hydroletilu: Movement speed -8%, spell haste -10%. A shell is carried, not simply worn.
Armor +3, shield bonus +15%. The depth taught his body to hold pressure.
Movement speed -8%, fire spell power -30%. Nothing warm survives that close.
Armor +2, frost spell power +2%, tenacity +8%. Three pieces of the deep, always turning.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_lisovyk_gre: With 16 leaf blocks within 5: tenacity +8%, movement speed +6%, earth spell power +5%.
With almost no leaves within 6: armor -2, damage taken +5%, roll cooldown +10%.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_lisovyk_roo: Movement speed -10%, roll cooldown +30%. Roots were never meant to travel.
While standing still: armor +3, knockback resistance +40%, tenacity +10%.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_lunaris_bon: While no other player is nearby: damage taken +18%, healing spell power -15%. A healer without a group is just a healer.
While another player is within 8 blocks: healing spell power +17%, armor +2. Together you are worth more than apart.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_lunaris_tid: In open sunlight: cast speed -10%, damage taken +8%, armor -1.
In the dark: cast speed +8%, evasion +6%.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_mara_ring_a: In the Nether: movement speed -8%, tenacity -8%, damage taken +8%, armor -2.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_mara_ring_w: In water or rain: movement speed +7%, evasion +6%.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_mara_shroud: Spell vampirism +10%, soul spell power +4%. It takes while she only looks.
-1 heart, healing received -20%. What the shroud takes does not come back to her.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_orc_bloodsc: -18% damage to targets at near-full health: an orc only warms up on blood.
+15% damage to targets below half health.
While any creature below half health is within 10 blocks: +5% movement speed, +6% warrior weapon damage. An orc smells it and comes.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_orc_shieldb: Armor -4, damage taken +15%. The swing matters more than the guard.
Armour piercing +25%: a quarter of the target's armor simply does not count. Stagger chance +12%: roughly one blow in eight knocks the target out of its own swing, and that swing is lost.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_serpentfolk: Tenacity +12%, spell resistance +8%. Nothing sticks to fresh scales for long.
Healing received -15%, armor -1. Fresh skin holds no blow.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_sylph_storm: -1 heart, damage taken +8%. She pays this one in clear weather, which is nearly always.
During a thunderstorm: air spell power +5%, lightning +3%, spell haste +10%, arrow velocity +15%. Only while it is actually storming.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_sylph_windl: While falling or jumping (over 1 block up): air spell power +5%, lightning spell power +3%, arrow velocity +14%. Only while her feet are off the ground.
-2 hearts, air spell power -18%. On the ground the wind ignores her.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_tiefling_bl: Natural regeneration is off: only potions, spells and other hands.
Below 30% health: all spell power +4%, spell vampirism +5%, movement speed +10%, spell haste +5%. The closer to the edge, the louder the spell.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_tiefling_te: Healing received -15%, damage taken +7%. A demon with no one to impress does not try very hard.
With an angel-blooded, an aurelite or an amberborn within 16 blocks: arcane spell power +4%, spell vampirism +8%, spell haste +8%.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_undead_bone: +12% damage from everything that is not a projectile. Bones handle arrows well and maces badly.
-45% damage from arrows, bolts and any projectiles: there is nothing between the bones to tear.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_undead_plag: Rogue weapon, axe and sickle damage -18%. The strength went into the rot.
Soul spell power +5%. A dead hand conducts another's power.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_undead_reap: -15% damage to targets above 70% health. A reaper cannot start a fight, only end one.
+30% damage to targets below 35% health, and each such hit heals you half a heart.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_undine_curr: Evasion chance +8%, roll distance +14%. Water does not stand where it is struck.
-1 heart, damage taken +10%. The thinner the water, the easier it parts.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_undine_pear: Out of water: movement speed -5%, damage taken +5%.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_vortan_iron: While both hands are empty: all incoming damage -20%.
Rolls -1, movement speed -6%. He traded the roll for a stance.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_vortan_mome: -2 hearts, damage taken +8%. Momentum is bought with a lighter body.
Attack speed +8%, spell haste +8%, bow haste +8%. The tempo belongs to him, not to the fight.
power.yggdrasil_origins.path_werewolf_pa: Rogue weapon damage -10%, damage taken +6%. Running second is not running free.
With a pack leader within 30 blocks: rogue weapon damage +1%, warrior weapon +1%. A quarter of what the leader gains from you.
With no pack member within 20 blocks: rogue weapon damage -10%, damage taken +7%. Without the pack he is only a beast.
With one pack member within 20 blocks: rogue weapon damage +3%, warrior weapon +4%. Only while no second pack leader is near.
A second pack member stacks on top: rogue weapon damage +3%, warrior weapon +4% again.
A third pack member stacks again: rogue weapon damage +3%, warrior weapon +4%. Three is the cap - +9% and +12% with the pack entire.
power.yggdrasil_origins.serpentfolk_coil: Evasion chance +4%, arcane spell power +5%. A body with no bones in the shoulders.
power.yggdrasil_origins.serpentfolk_cold: In snow and cold: movement speed -20%, spell haste -26%, attack speed -13%. Cold nearly shuts a serpentfolk down.
power.yggdrasil_origins.serpentfolk_immu: Poison and wither have no effect at all.
power.yggdrasil_origins.serpentfolk_swim: Swim speed +21%, oxygen +4. Water is a serpent’s second road.
power.yggdrasil_origins.serpentfolk_thin: -3 hearts, damage taken +44%, warrior weapon damage -45%. Nothing to hold heavy steel with.
power.yggdrasil_origins.serpentfolk_veno: Rogue weapon and dagger damage +11%. A serpent strikes precisely, not heavily.
power.yggdrasil_origins.sylph_caged.desc: Under a roof or underground: air spell power -25%, evasion chance -4%. With no sky overhead there is no wind, and no power with it.
power.yggdrasil_origins.sylph_caged.name: No Sky Above
power.yggdrasil_origins.sylph_evasive.de: Evasion chance +6%, roll distance +21%, rolls +1. Hard to touch.
power.yggdrasil_origins.sylph_gossamer.d: -3 hearts, damage taken +11%. A body of gossamer and air.
Lightning spell power +5%. A storm is home.
power.yggdrasil_origins.sylph_no_heavy.d: Shield bonus -36%, hammer, claymore and mace damage -25%, warrior weapon -29%. Heavy iron nails her down.
power.yggdrasil_origins.sylph_rooted_fea: Earth spell power -43%. Stone smothers wind.
power.yggdrasil_origins.sylph_storm_magi: Air spell power +5%, ranged damage +10%, arrow velocity +13%. Wind carries both word and arrow.
power.yggdrasil_origins.sylph_updraft.de: While falling: gravity -42%, movement speed +6%. A fall is the start of a glide.
power.yggdrasil_origins.sylph_weightless: Gravity -21%, safe fall distance +5, movement speed +5%. Weight is negotiable.
Arcane spell power +6%, fire spell power +5%, wand damage +17%, knuckles +20%. Magic in the blood, not in books.
power.yggdrasil_origins.tiefling_cursed_: Healing received -18%, damage taken +6%. Cursed flesh takes help poorly.
power.yggdrasil_origins.tiefling_demon_b: Burning time -49%, -1 hearts. Demon blood warms and gnaws.
power.yggdrasil_origins.tiefling_holy_we: Healing spell power -90%. Holy words choke him.
power.yggdrasil_origins.tiefling_lava_bo: Lava carries you the way water carries a swimmer, and you see through it instead of a wall of orange. It still burns - this is movement and sight, not immunity.
power.yggdrasil_origins.tiefling_no_shie: Shield bonus -36%. He does not hide behind a shield.
power.yggdrasil_origins.tiefling_spell_v: Spell vampirism +15%. A spell returns part of its power.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undead_carrion.d: Rotten flesh, spider eyes and poisonous potatoes no longer poison you and feed 50% better — this is his normal food.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undead_dead_pala: All normal food feeds 35% worse: a dead tongue barely tastes it.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undead_drowned_w: You cannot swim and sink like a stone - but the dead do not breathe, so you cannot drown. A ward switches the whole thing off: you swim like the living, and you drown like them too.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undead_grave_rea: Sickle damage +13%, rogue weapon +10%, axe +9%. The undead reaps a harvest of souls.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undead_holy_weak: Healing spell power -60%, fire spell power -24%. Light burns even in a spell.
Fall damage -25%, burning time +30%. The dead ignore falls, not fire.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undead_lifesteal: Lifesteal +18%. Another’s life is the only fuel.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undead_minion.de: 15% chance on hit to raise a silverfish: it charges your enemy, is tougher than usual and crumbles after 20 seconds.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undead_no_healin: Healing received -49%. Dead flesh does not mend.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undead_paladin_w: Paladin weapon damage -30%. Holy weapons scald the palms.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undead_rotten_bo: Armor -3, damage taken +30%, movement speed -3%. Armor barely holds on rotten flesh.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undead_shield_wa: With a shield in the off hand: sickle damage +5%. The guard steadies the swing.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undead_soul_magi: Soul spell power +5%. Souls answer their own.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undead_sunburn.d: You catch fire in direct sunlight. A Fire Resistance potion switches this off entirely. A Warding Draught or a Ward Gem in your inventory switches this off entirely.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undine_dissolved: All beneficial potions last 40% longer: her body holds a brew like water holds dye.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undine_fluid_for: Water movement +0.75, swim speed +40%, oxygen +10, evasion +8%. The body flows where others brace.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undine_healing_c: Healing spell power +32%, frost spell power +5%. The current washes wounds away.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undine_landbound: Out of water: spell haste -18%, healing spell power -15%. Out of water the magic runs dry.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undine_nether_ba: In the Nether out of water you dry out for 1 heart every 4 seconds. A Warding Draught or a Ward Gem in your inventory switches this off entirely.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undine_rejuvenat: In water, half a heart regenerates every 4 seconds.
Fire spell power -83%, burning time +69%. Fire evaporates her nature.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undine_soaked_cu: All harmful effects also last 40% longer — poison does not rinse out of her.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undine_soft_shel: -2 hearts, armor -2, shield bonus -49%. Soft scales make poor armor.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undine_tide_magi: Water spell power +8%. The tide answers her word.
power.yggdrasil_origins.undine_water_eye: Under water she sees as clearly as on a bright day. On land it is of no use to her.
power.yggdrasil_origins.vortan_empty_han: With an empty hand: unarmed damage +4.5, movement speed +10%. He is the weapon.
power.yggdrasil_origins.vortan_fists.des: Attack speed +30%, knuckles damage +13%. He fights bare-handed.
power.yggdrasil_origins.vortan_flow.desc: Rolls +1, roll distance +21%, evasion chance +5%. He flows through the fight.
power.yggdrasil_origins.vortan_flow.name: Flow
power.yggdrasil_origins.vortan_inner_for: Arcane spell power +6%. The power comes from within.
power.yggdrasil_origins.vortan_lean.desc: -1 hearts, damage taken +2%, shield bonus -33%. Nothing to block with.
power.yggdrasil_origins.vortan_lean.name: Lean
No heavy armor: neither RPG melee sets nor vanilla iron, diamond or netherite. Light and magic armor is fine.
power.yggdrasil_origins.vortan_weaponles: While holding any weapon: attack damage -46%, attack speed -21%, spell haste -29%. He can hold a weapon; it just does nothing for him.
power.yggdrasil_origins.werewolf_beast_m: All spell power -53%. A beast does not study spells.
power.yggdrasil_origins.werewolf_claws.d: Dagger damage +32%. Claws tear, they do not cut.
power.yggdrasil_origins.werewolf_curse.d: Healing received -23%, healing spell power -90%. Cursed flesh mends poorly.
power.yggdrasil_origins.werewolf_keen_se: Sees in the dark without potions — beast eyes are used to it.
power.yggdrasil_origins.werewolf_night_h: Out of direct sunlight: movement speed +40%, crit chance +32%, rogue weapon damage +13%, warrior weapon +5%. The night belongs to him.
power.yggdrasil_origins.werewolf_no_bows: Bows and crossbows cannot be used — claws do not hold a bowstring.
power.yggdrasil_origins.werewolf_sun_wea: In direct sunlight: movement speed -23%, damage taken +12%, rogue weapon damage -8%. Daylight drains the beast out of him.
